Senses.Note: The different grammatical placements do not warrant a split: noun, modifier, and extent readings all designate completeness of the same referent. The deviation lies in the recurring public formulas 'the whole body appears' (全體現) and 'the whole body is exposed' (全體露), not in an imported claim about a metaphysical 'total reality.' Occurrences.Kwic: 既是一顆明珠，學人為甚不識？沙曰：全體是珠，更教誰識？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Xuansha Shibei owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 極目青天無片雲，萬象森羅全體露。若也擬議更商量，特地翻成箇露布。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Kaixian Zhixun owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 舉拂子云。盧舍本身全體現。當機直下沒纖毫。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Yuanwu Keqin owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 驀拈拄杖云：「龍袖拂開全體現，象王行處絕狐蹤。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (密雲禪師語錄). Miyun Yuanwu owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當機微笑，窺見一斑；依位無言，猶虧全體。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄). an unnamed questioning monk owns the exact clause in the complete case.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The complete-case markers assign the exact clause to an unnamed questioning monk.

Occurrences.Kwic: 如賓主相見，便有言論往來，或應物現形，或全體作用，或把機權喜怒，或現半身，或乘獅子，或乘象王。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (列祖提綱錄). Linji Yixuan owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山曰。龍袖拂開全體現。曰師意如何。山曰。象王行處絕狐踪。師於言下大悟拜起而曰。萬古碧潭空界月。再三撈摝始應知。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (續傳燈錄). Fenyang Shanzhao owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 受用，拄杖不用得。昭云：但將去，有用處在。師便收。昭云：又道不用。師喝一喝，便下去。昭云：已後不讓臨濟。師云：正令已行。昭來日送出三門，云：汝介丘逢尉遲時如何？師云：一刀兩段。昭云：被現那吒又怎生？師便拽拄杖。昭喝云：遮回全體分

Senses.Explanation: the entire body. Xuansha's pearl exchange says, 'the whole body is the pearl—who else would you have recognize it?' Teaching-seat verses pair a raised whisk, staff, dust mote, or opened sleeve with the whole body's appearing.
